title: SankeyQA, career-map Sankey diagrams with exact answers, benchmark data, model replies and code
description: SankeyQA is an open benchmark for testing whether vision-language models can answer questions about career-map Sankey diagrams, of the kind shown by the XR-CareerAssist virtual reality career guidance platform (VOXReality, Horizon Europe). It contains 600 artificial career cohorts, generated by a computer program only to demonstrate and test the technology (the data are not real, contain no personal data and do not come from any real career database), their flow tables, 1,260 career-map images in twelve drawing styles and 6,560 questions whose answers are computed exactly from the flow tables. The release also contains the code that generates the benchmark, evaluates five small open models and two baselines, fine-tunes BLIP-VQA on 20 to 400 maps and draws the figures, every model reply, all result tables and the figures of the accompanying article 'Reading the picture or reading the data? An open benchmark of career-map Sankey diagrams for small vision-language models' (submitted to Open Research Europe). Code under the Apache License 2.0, data, replies, results and figures under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA.md). Version 1.1.0 adds the extended data of the article (question templates, exact inputs of every reader, drawing styles, simulation settings, full result tables with intervals for every drawing style and an example map in all twelve styles). The benchmark data, replies and results are those of version 1.0.0.
